source_text: Angelus Domini in via obstat. Asina videt quod propheta non videt; stulta mundi eligit Deus ut confundat sapientes.
pass_a_gloss: Angel of-Lord in way stands-against. Donkey sees what prophet not sees; foolish of-world chooses God that he-may-confound wise.
pass_b_english: [[The angel of the Lord blocks the way >> Bible:Numbers 22:22-27]]. The donkey sees what the prophet does not; [[God chose the foolish of the world to shame the wise >> Bible:1 Corinthians 1:27]].
